@overview 字彙王 Level 3–5 練習題本。答案與中文詞義已與教材官方解答逐題核對；題目文字為照片轉錄。本單元請抽查：部分句子左側邊緣被切到，開頭文字依語意補回。

@group A 文意字彙（1–5）：依提示寫出正確的字

Q 1 | fill | 文意字彙
stem: The student a______ted the position of his chair so that he could see the blackboard.
= adjusted
~詞義 adjust（v.）調整
~原文 The student adjusted the position of his chair so that he could see the blackboard.

Q 2 | fill | 文意字彙
stem: To the fans' d______t, the concert was canceled due to sudden weather changes that made outdoor performances unsafe.
= disappointment
~詞義 disappointment（n.）失望
~原文 To the fans' disappointment, the concert was canceled due to sudden weather changes that made outdoor performances unsafe.

Q 3 | fill | 文意字彙
stem: Ken is a successful painter whose works are displayed in several art g______ries in the city.
= galleries
~詞義 gallery（n.）畫廊
~原文 Ken is a successful painter whose works are displayed in several art galleries in the city.

Q 4 | fill | 文意字彙
stem: Emissions from the new factory will have a negative i______t on the local environment, so the residents are protesting against it.
= impact
~詞義 impact（n.）影響
~原文 Emissions from the new factory will have a negative impact on the local environment, so the residents are protesting against it.

Q 5 | fill | 文意字彙
stem: Charlie is one of the most i______l scholars in his field. His outstanding research has inspired many.
= influential
~詞義 influential（adj.）有影響力的
~原文 Charlie is one of the most influential scholars in his field. His outstanding research has inspired many.

@group B 選擇題（6–10）

Q 6 | choice | 選擇題
stem: If you look at successful people from around the world, you'll find that bravery and confidence are two common ______ among them.
A: economists
B: characteristics
C: sculptures
D: adjustments
= B
~詞義 characteristic（n.）特色;特徵
~原文 If you look at successful people from around the world, you'll find that bravery and confidence are two common characteristics among them.

Q 7 | choice | 選擇題
stem: Red blood cells ______ in the blood and carry oxygen from the lungs to the rest of the body.
A: circulate
B: devote
C: recycle
D: measure
= A
~詞義 circulate（v.）循環
~原文 Red blood cells circulate in the blood and carry oxygen from the lungs to the rest of the body.

Q 8 | choice | 選擇題
stem: In our company, the work schedule is really ______; as long as we can finish our tasks, we can choose our own working hours.
A: permanent
B: economical
C: artificial
D: flexible
= D
~詞義 flexible（adj.）有彈性的
~原文 In our company, the work schedule is really flexible; as long as we can finish our tasks, we can choose our own working hours.

Q 9 | choice | 選擇題
stem: Owing to a severe ______ in the wound on his leg, the patient is now in a critical condition and has to be monitored at all times.
A: infection
B: defense
C: laboratory
D: adjustment
= A
~詞義 infection（n.）感染
~原文 Owing to a severe infection in the wound on his leg, the patient is now in a critical condition and has to be monitored at all times.

Q 10 | choice | 選擇題
stem: Hedy grabbed a ruler to ______ the length of the book.
A: rebel
B: transfer
C: measure
D: neglect
= C
~詞義 measure（v.）測量
~原文 Hedy grabbed a ruler to measure the length of the book.

@group C 配合題（11–15）：從單字庫選出最適合的字

@bank
A: generations
B: campaigned
C: eliminated
D: landscapes
E: facilities
F: endangered

Q 11 | bank | 配合題
stem: The report highlighted several ______ species whose homes were shrinking because of rapid urban development.
= F
~詞義 endangered（adj.）瀕危的
~原文 The report highlighted several endangered species whose homes were shrinking because of rapid urban development.

Q 12 | bank | 配合題
stem: The research lab is getting pretty old, so the department is planning to upgrade the ______.
= E
~詞義 facility（n.）設備
~原文 The research lab is getting pretty old, so the department is planning to upgrade the facilities.

Q 13 | bank | 配合題
stem: The police still had not ______ the possibility of murder, even though the body was not marked or bruised.
= C
~詞義 eliminate（v.）消除
~原文 The police still had not eliminated the possibility of murder, even though the body was not marked or bruised.

Q 14 | bank | 配合題
stem: Environmental groups ______ against the new factory, arguing that it would damage local wildlife and worsen air quality.
= B
~詞義 campaign（v.）發起運動
~原文 Environmental groups campaigned against the new factory, arguing that it would damage local wildlife and worsen air quality.

Q 15 | bank | 配合題
stem: The photographer is famous for his amazing photos of natural ______.
= D
~詞義 landscape（n.）風景
~原文 The photographer is famous for his amazing photos of natural landscapes.

@group C 配合題（16–20）：從單字庫選出最適合的字

@bank
A: passive
B: universe
C: economy
D: recycling
E: neglect
F: objective

Q 16 | bank | 配合題
stem: The government is considering a series of measures to boost the ______.
= C
~詞義 economy（n.）經濟
~原文 The government is considering a series of measures to boost the economy.

Q 17 | bank | 配合題
stem: When grading essays, a teacher must stay ______ and review every student's work according to the same standard.
= F
~詞義 objective（adj.）客觀的
~原文 When grading essays, a teacher must stay objective and review every student's work according to the same standard.

Q 18 | bank | 配合題
stem: Many people nowadays are so busy with work that they ______ their health.
= E
~詞義 neglect（v.）忽視
~原文 Many people nowadays are so busy with work that they neglect their health.

Q 19 | bank | 配合題
stem: ______ reduces the amount of waste, thus protecting wildlife habitats and improving the overall environment.
= D
~詞義 recycling（n.）回收
~原文 Recycling reduces the amount of waste, thus protecting wildlife habitats and improving the overall environment.

Q 20 | bank | 配合題
stem: Traditionally, women were encouraged to play a(n) ______ role in society, while men were expected to be far more active.
= A
~詞義 passive（adj.）被動的
~原文 Traditionally, women were encouraged to play a(n) passive role in society, while men were expected to be far more active.
